color.note: Two layers. Product UI (app.haysam.school and Haysam websites): lavender-white background, white surfaces with 1px line borders, ink for primary actions, yellow only as a small highlight. Media (posts and covers): lavender canvas, one accent per design (yellow or fire), the Night theme for night and cinema covers. Never lime or acid green.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand ink. Primary buttons, selected chips, kicker labels, icons in icon tiles, logo. White on it is 13.7:1.

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of primary buttons. White on it is 11.3:1.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Brand yellow. In UI only for small highlights: step numbers and numbered markers, with ink text (10.6:1). In media it is an accent.

tokens.name: yellow-soft
tokens.usage: Soft yellow behind an ink icon in a 40px icon tile (12.6:1).

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Lavanda. Default canvas of media designs and top stop of the post canvas gradient.

tokens.name: lavender-white
tokens.usage: Oq-lavanda. The UI page background; bottom stop of the post canvas gradient.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Surfaces: cards, panels, inputs on focus. Text and logos on night and on photos.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Tun. Media only: dark canvas for night and cinema covers.

tokens.name: fire
tokens.usage: Olov. Media only: comet trail, cursor, selection box. Never in product UI.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: UI page background. Also the fill of inputs, tab bars and chips at rest.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: UI cards, panels, nav, selected tab, focused input.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: UI body text and headings, on background (18.4:1) and surface (19.6:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary UI text: descriptions, helper text, nav links, captions, unselected chips and tabs. 6.7:1 on background, 7.2:1 on surface.

tokens.name: text-placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholders and empty states. 2.8:1 on background, below 4.5:1: never use it for real content.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px borders of cards, inputs, chips, tabs, nav, dividers. Decorative (1.2:1); controls also carry a fill or label.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input border on hover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button and selected-chip fill.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on primary.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Step numbers and numbered markers, with ink text.

tokens.name: icon-bg
tokens.usage: Icon tile background, with an ink Phosphor icon.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (2px, offset 2px) and focused input border. 3.7:1 on background, 3.9:1 on surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors: invalid input border and error text. 6.2:1 on background.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success: the done state of copy buttons. 6.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code block background.

tokens.name: code-text
tokens.usage: Code block text, 15.4:1 on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-button
tokens.usage: Copy button inside a code block; white label (13:1).

tokens.name: code-button-hover
tokens.usage: Copy button hover.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Floating nav background, with a 16px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: glass-menu
tokens.usage: Full-screen mobile menu background, with a 24px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: hero-from
tokens.usage: Start of the hero heading gradient (left).

tokens.name: hero-to
tokens.usage: End of the hero heading gradient (right).

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Media: post and cover ground. Lavender, or flat night in the Night theme.

tokens.name: canvas-end
tokens.usage: Media: bottom stop of the post canvas gradient.

tokens.name: post-text
tokens.usage: Media: headlines on posts. Ink on lavender (11.4:1), white on night (18.9:1).

tokens.name: dot-grid
tokens.usage: Media: dots of the dot-grid pattern on lavender. Decoration only.

tokens.name: sky-light
tokens.usage: Media: offer gradient, first stop. Offers and prices only.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Media: offer gradient, middle stop.

tokens.name: sky-deep
tokens.usage: Media: offer gradient, last stop.

tokens.name: metal-light
tokens.usage: Media: last stop of the ink-metal lettering gradient (night, ink, metal-light).

type.note: Product UI uses Geist and Geist Mono only, on the scale below. Media posts use one mood font per post (JetBrains Mono, Anton, Unbounded, Archivo Black, Big Shoulders Display, Instrument Serif, Bricolage Grotesque) and Inter for post chips. All faces are OFL.

styles.name: heading-3

styles.name: title-1

styles.name: title-2

styles.name: title-3

styles.name: body-3

styles.name: body-4

styles.name: body-5

styles.name: body-6

styles.name: button-lg

styles.name: button-md
styles.usage: Default buttons in forms and panels (40px tall).

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: Nav button, chips, tabs (36px tall).

styles.name: button-xsm

styles.name: caption-1

styles.name: caption-2

styles.name: caption-3
styles.usage: Kickers and panel labels (with hs-kicker: caps, ink, 0.06em); step numbers (in mono).

styles.name: headline-brand

styles.name: headline-news
styles.usage: News mood: news and loud caps. Set in caps.

styles.name: headline-future

styles.name: headline-premium

styles.name: headline-play

styles.usage: One supporting line under a headline, as in the brand-book carousel. Use the post's mood font or Instrument Serif.

styles.name: sticker-label

spacing.note: One 4px-based scale for UI and media layouts.

tokens.name: s-25
tokens.usage: Tight padding of step numbers and inline code.

tokens.name: s-50
tokens.usage: Eyebrow padding (block), tab bar padding and gap, copy-button padding (block).

tokens.name: s-75
tokens.usage: Button and input padding (block), icon-to-label gap, gap between chips, title-to-text gap in cards.

tokens.name: s-100
tokens.usage: Button and input padding (inline), chip padding (inline).

tokens.name: s-200
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and form fields; nav offset from the top; mobile section gutter.

tokens.name: s-300
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; page gutter; gap between form groups.

tokens.name: s-400
tokens.usage: Gap between a form and its preview; space above hero actions.

tokens.name: s-500
tokens.usage: Space under a section title; numbered-list indent.

tokens.name: s-600
tokens.usage: Gap between the two columns of a split layout.

tokens.name: s-700
tokens.usage: Space above a hero visual.

tokens.name: s-800
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile; space under the hero.

tokens.name: s-900
tokens.usage: Section padding (block) on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Step numbers, inline code, copy buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon tiles, tabs, focus outline, menu button.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, code blocks, tab bars, accordion items, images.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, steps, the floating nav, inner panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large panels: forms, install and output panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Eyebrow badges, chips, numbered circles, pills.

tokens.name: radius-sticker
tokens.usage: Media: mono stickers.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Media: tool-logo tiles on a 1080px post.

shadow.note: UI is flat: borders, not shadows. Shadows only for the selected tab and floating media cards. Media glows use the hue of the element they surround.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Selected tab in a tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Floating cover previews and media cards over the UI.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: Media: tool-logo tiles and chips on a post.

tokens.name: shadow-pop-yellow
tokens.usage: Media: rim and glow of a yellow pop button.

tokens.name: shadow-pop-fire
tokens.usage: Media: rim and glow of a fire pop button.

layout.note: UI widths and breakpoints, then media formats. The media master is 1080x1920; the 4:5 feed crop and the 3:4 profile grid must still work.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max width of page sections and the footer.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of hero titles, lead text and simple text pages.

tokens.name: measure-wide
tokens.usage: Max width of accordions and statement lines.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: Below this, split layouts and the form/preview pair stack.

tokens.name: breakpoint-sm
tokens.usage: Below this, the nav collapses to a menu button and headings step down.

tokens.name: blur-nav
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind the floating nav.

tokens.name: blur-menu
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind the mobile menu.

tokens.name: canvas-width
tokens.usage: Media: width of every post and cover.

tokens.name: story-height
tokens.usage: Media: Reels and Stories cover master (9:16).

tokens.name: feed-height
tokens.usage: Media: feed post and carousel slide (4:5).

tokens.name: safe-top
tokens.usage: Media: top of the band that holds everything important on a 1080x1920 cover.

tokens.name: safe-bottom

tokens.name: reels-ui-right

tokens.usage: Media: where the right-hand Reels buttons zone starts.

tokens.name: reels-ui-bottom

tokens.name: post-margin

tokens.name: logo-height

tokens.name: dot-pitch

tokens.name: line-pitch
tokens.usage: Media: line-grid spacing on a 1080px canvas (2px lines).
